title: Frog Flies and Swims
summary: A frog learns to fly with a dragonfly friend using initial blends.

pages.text: A frog sat by the pond.
pages.scene: A green frog on a lily pad in still water

pages.text: A fly came and said hello.
pages.scene: A bright dragonfly hovering above the water

pages.text: The frog can swim and splash.
pages.scene: The frog swimming quickly, creating splashes
The frog looking up at the dragonfly with wonder

pages.text: No, but you can skip and leap!
pages.scene: The frog jumping high off the lily pad

pages.text: The frog tried to jump up.
pages.scene: Frog leaping through the air with effort

pages.text: Up, up, up went the frog!
pages.scene: Frog soaring higher than before, almost flying

pages.text: The frog can fly and float!
pages.scene: Frog seeming to hang in air like the dragonfly

pages.text: We can play and stop to rest.
pages.scene: Frog and dragonfly playing together in the sun
Happy frog and dragonfly hovering side by side
Frog and dragonfly as a team triumphant
